title: Obsidian Drops OP Loot
body:
Makes obsidian (Only when broken with a diamond or netherite pickaxe) drop very overpowered items like netherite armor and tools, diamonds and even totems of undying.

You could use it for minecraft challenges or just for fun or if you want to make the game easier to beat.

This mod probably also works for some versions other than 1.20.1 but I haven't checked, so I don't know for sure.
